terrarianmight.midnightconfig.title: Terrarian Might
terrarianmight.midnightconfig.crystalHea: The amount of health you gain from using a Life Crystal.
terrarianmight.midnightconfig.crystalMax: The maximum amount of health you can gain from Life Crystals.
terrarianmight.midnightconfig.crystalCoo: The amount of time Life Crystals will be on cooldown for after using.
terrarianmight.midnightconfig.crystalGro: The max amount of time it takes for Life Crystal buds to grow. (Budding Amethyst Value = 5)
terrarianmight.midnightconfig.fruitNeeds: Whether or not Life Fruit need max health to eat.
terrarianmight.midnightconfig.fruitCoold: The amount of time Life Fruit will be on cooldown for after eating.
terrarianmight.midnightconfig.fruitDurat: The amount of time the Health Boost effect gained from Life Fruit lasts for.
NOTE: This option requires a game restart to be applied.
terrarianmight.midnightconfig.fruitAmpli: The amplifier of the Health Boost effect gained from Life Fruit.
NOTE: This option requires a game restart to be applied.
terrarianmight.midnightconfig.lanternRep: Whether or not you can repair Heart Lanterns with Life Shards.
terrarianmight.midnightconfig.lanternDur: The amount of time the Regeneration effect gained from Heart Lanterns lasts for.
terrarianmight.midnightconfig.lanternAmp: The amplifier of the Regeneration effect gained from Heart Lanterns.
terrarianmight.midnightconfig.lanternSca: Whether or not the level of the Heart Lantern's amplifier increases (by 1) depending on its damaged state.
alert.terrarianmight.life_crystal_limit: You have already reached max health!
alert.terrarianmight.life_fruit_disallow: You haven't reached max health yet!
